information: Welcome to the first ever post-pandemic WCA competition in the Panay Island outside Iloilo province: **Capiz Cube Craze 2024**. The competition is brought to you by Panay Speedcubers, with the help of Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee. By registering, competitors and its guests, including but not limited to: family members, friends, and guardians, must agree that the organizations involved, its personnels, and specific individuals, are not liable for any harm and injury, loss of personal belongings, property and emotional damage resulting in your participation of this competition. Please note that the schedule posted on the website may be advance or behind depending on the flow of the actual competition. Please be familiar with the WCA Regulations and its guidelines before participating in this event. Bea Alexandra Marie Flores will act as emergency delegate for this competition.
